newsitem.title: HUNGARY: RWE'S HUNGARIAN POWER PLANT FACES WAGE STRIKE - MTI.
newsitem.headline: RWE'S HUNGARIAN POWER PLANT FACES WAGE STRIKE - MTI.

text.p: Electricity industrial employees of Hungary's Matrai Eromu Rt power plant will go on strike on February 27, unless a two-hour warning strike on February 26 results in a wage agreement with the employers, Hungarian news agency MTI said.

The power plant's 1,300 electricity industrial employees demand a 22 percent wage increase, while the owner, Germany's RWE/Energie Versorgung Schwaben AG is willing to raise wages by 18 percent, MTI said.
It added that the employer was unwilling to negotiate a compromise offer of employees for a 20.5 percent rise.
MTI said that miners of the power plant, which has a total workforce of 4,500, signed an agreement about an 18 percent rise.
The Hungarian government targets an inflation of around 17 percent for 1997.
